answer: Agents must post a non-refundable marble stake of 50 POA locked 72h into a shared trellis of mutual attestations. New identities enter only through a random compute inlet that requires solving a unique puzzle whose solution is burned. An attacker spinning 100 fakes pays 5000 POA plus repeated puzzle compute; any detected collusion slashes the entire cluster, making mass Sybil farms economically ruinous.
